heading: **23 October 2025**
body:
### 1. Large scale reconstitution of 293T & GP5d 20K

*293T-20K \[x2\]*

Use 3.89 ug of DNA \[3.76 uL \+ 11.24 uL TE buffer\]

*293T-20K* (D4) ⇒ 15 uL ⇒ 15 nM \[at 2 M salt concentration\]

Octamer molarity acc. to 60:1 ratio ⇒ 0.9 uM ⇒ 1.96 ug in 5 uL ⇒ Prepare 12 uL of stock with 500 ng/uL with refolding buffer \[1.11 uL stock \+ 8.89 uL refolding buffer\] \[O500\] ⇒ Prepare 5 uL octamer stock \[3.92 uL \+ 1.08 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol\] \[1.78 M\] ⇒ Final concentration of mix \[1.95 M\]

*GP5d-20K \[x1\]*

Use 3.89 ug of DNA \[				\]

*GP5d-20K* (D5) ⇒ 15 uL ⇒ 15 nM \[at 2 M salt concentration\]

Prepare 5 uL octamer stock \[3.92 uL O500 \+ 1.08 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol\] \[1.78 M\] ⇒ Final concentration of mix \[1.95 M\]

This trial is being run at 1.5 mL/min (pump 1\) & 1.3 mL/min (pump 2\)

### 2. Combined ligation of different ligand patterns

I have lig147 & ligN40w107 post PNK treatment. Set up ligation reactions for these with 500 ng each of both the ligands. In this context there will be lesser molecules of ligN40w107 in 500 ng as compared to lig147  because of the higher molecular weight of ligN40w107.

| DNA | 1000 ng |
| :---- | :---- |
| PEG8000 | 3 uL |
| 1 mM CoHex | 1 uL |
| Ligase Buffer (10X) | 1 uL |
| T4 DNA ligase | 1 uL |

### 3. Quantification of D1, D2, B3 & B4 samples post *Hia5* treatment

Qubit was used to estimate the concentration of the samples. No DNA was seen in the supernatant from the Ampure XP purification. For the final eluted samples:

D1-H-E : 1.71 ng/uL (\~170 ng yield)

D2-H-E : 3.88 ng/uL (\~380 ng yield)

For B3 & B4 the values could not be detected using the Qubit assay → suggesting very low concentration values → potentially needs to be concentrated more

Check for 6mA using *DpnI* & *MboI*

Samples processed : lig20K, B3-H, D1-H

| DNA | 10 ng |
| :---- | :---- |
| rCutsmart Buffer | 1 uL |
| DpnI/MboI | 0.2 uL |
| Total  | 10 uL |

DpnI

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 20 mins |

Run the gel in the following order:

1. 1 kb plus ladder  
2. 100 bp ladder  
3. lig20K non-treated  
4. lig20K DpnI  
5. lig20K MboI  
6. B3-H non-treated  
7. B3-H DpnI  
8. B3-H MboI  
9. D1-H non-treated  
10. D1-H DpnI  
11. D1-H MboI

Run at 95 V, 50 mins. Stain with SYBR green for \~ 1 hour.
